spec.name: Quiet names v9
spec.notes: Long the calm names, short the jumpy ones.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.6, annual return 6%, maximum drawdown 6%.

exhibits.summary: On the sealed period, traded as live (strict data, 10 bps, at least one bar of lag), the Sharpe ratio is 1.84 against 1.59 in research, a gap of -0.25.
The log holds 4 distinct specs; the best of 4 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.21, so the claimed 1.60 becomes 1.39 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 100%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 1.62 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean 0.01, 95th percentile 0.60).
Perturbing the 1 numeric value in the signal by up to 50% moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.59 to as low as 1.27 (as low as 1.45 at 25%).
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 1.59 against 1.59 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.
Delaying the signal by 1 more bar moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.59 to 1.58 (change -0.01).

verdict.opinion: The strategy's performance metrics are supported by multiple exhibits showing robustness and consistency across different tests. No charges were filed, and the defense did not provide any rebuttals. The strategy appears valid and ready for deployment.
